title: UAP SPP 201 Pre-Design and Service Boundaries
subject: Professional Practice

questions.stem: Which listed service is clearly a Pre-design Service under SPP Document 201?

options.D: Issuance of a Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance

rationale.correct: SPP 201 identifies Architectural Programming as a pre-design service.

distractors.B: Fulltime Construction Supervision is separately identified as not covered by the 401-402 agreement.
distractors.C: Design-Build is explicitly not the 401-402 agreement and is a different service arrangement.
distractors.D: FSEC is a fire-code clearance process, not the cited SPP 201 pre-design service.

rationale.takeaway: Classify the service family before answering.

questions.source_locator: UAP SPP Document 201, Architectural Programming, PDF p.48.

questions.stem: Under SPP 201, why is consultation still compensable professional input even if the project is not pursued?

options.A: The architect renders advice, evaluation, appraisal, and direction whether or not the client proceeds.
options.B: Consultation automatically creates a design-build contract.
options.C: Consultation replaces signed and sealed architectural documents.
options.D: Consultation is only free preliminary marketing.

rationale.correct: The excerpt says the architect renders valuable inputs whether or not the client pursues the project.

distractors.B: Design-build is a different arrangement and not created by consultation.
distractors.C: Consultation does not replace architectural documents.
distractors.D: SPP 201 treats it as valuable professional input, not free marketing.

rationale.takeaway: Do not dismiss oral/written advice as non-service when SPP 201 classifies it.

questions.source_locator: UAP SPP Document 201, Consultation, PDF p.42.

questions.stem: Under UAP Document 401-402, which service is explicitly not covered by the agreement?

options.B: Periodic visits during construction phase service
options.D: Contract document forms as part of construction phase service

rationale.correct: Document 401-402 states the agreement does not cover Fulltime Construction Supervision, among other services.

distractors.B: The excerpt includes periodic visits in the 5% construction-phase service, not the separately engaged fulltime supervision.
distractors.C: Preparation of plans/specifications is the primary service described in the excerpt.
distractors.D: Contract document forms are listed under the 5% construction-phase service.

rationale.takeaway: Separate periodic construction-phase service from fulltime construction supervision.

questions.source_locator: UAP Document 401-402, Articles 5-6 and 7.08, PDF pp.1 and 8.
